title: carried-debt.jsonl record
description: JSON Schema for a single JSONL record in out/carried-debt.jsonl. The file is append-only; each record is one JSON object with a `crc32` field over the serialized JSON body excluding that field, per v3.3-architecture.md §6.5b. State transitions and the post-merge-audit (β) predicate are defined in v3.3/tables/cd-state-machine.yaml. Field names mirror the §6.5b prose exactly so the §6.5 digest_emit Carried Debt predicate's (α)/(β)/(γ) clauses can be evaluated mechanically against records of this schema.

ts.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp with millisecond precision.

cd_id.description: Stable identifier for the carried-debt entry. cd_open is the only record kind that may introduce a new cd_id; subsequent records (cd_tick, cd_close, cd_block) MUST reference an existing cd_id.

crc32.description: CRC32 over the JSON body of this record excluding the crc32 field itself. Detects truncation and silent corruption per §6.5b.

lane_history_ref.description: Literal string reference to the lane-history.jsonl line index that surfaced this debt (typically a merge_authority:post_merge_invariant_violated lane_pause), or literal none for operator-originated debt. The §6.5 digest_emit Carried Debt predicate clause (α) compares this field for exact equality against `lane-history.jsonl:N`.

ttl_cycles_initial.description: TTL at open time, in cycles. Default 1 per rulebook §6.4 one-cycle carry-forward TTL; higher values require explicit operator authorization.

ttl_cycles_remaining.description: Current TTL. On cd_open this MUST equal ttl_cycles_initial. Each cd_tick decrements this by 1; the §6.5 (β) predicate accepts (status==open AND ttl_cycles_remaining>=1) OR (status==blocked).

blocking.description: If true, this CD entry transitions to status==blocked (via cd_block) when ttl_cycles_remaining reaches 0; once any blocking CD is in status==blocked, new feature work is forbidden until it transitions to closed.

status.description: Initial status at cd_open. MUST be the literal string 'open'; cd_close/cd_block transitions are recorded by their respective record kinds, not by re-asserting status on subsequent records.

item_text.description: One-sentence human-readable summary of the debt item. Rendered verbatim into docs/next-session.md by Phase 4.

source_text.description: Verbatim snippet from the source event (e.g. the lane_pause details field). Distinct from item_text: source_text records the raw evidence, item_text is the operator-facing summary.

opened_at_lane_history_index.description: lane-history.jsonl line index AT WHICH this cd_open record is opened (i.e. the index the cd_open's own emission corresponds to, NOT lane_history_ref). Per §10.8, opened_at_lane_history_index MUST be no greater than N+2 where N is the lane_history_ref line index, allowing the slot for the state_recovery successor event.

ttl_cycles_remaining.description: TTL value AFTER this tick decrement is applied (i.e. previous ttl_cycles_remaining minus 1). A cd_tick that would yield a negative value is L4 — the orchestrator MUST emit cd_block on the same tick instead.

target_cycle_id.description: UUIDv7 cycle_id from the cycle_boundary event that triggered this tick batch. Per v3.3/tables/cycle-clock.yaml the cycle_boundary record MUST appear in lane-history.jsonl and be fsynced BEFORE this cd_tick is appended to carried-debt.jsonl.

closed_at_lane_history_index.description: lane-history.jsonl line index at which the close happened (typically a merge event whose diff resolved the drift).

close_reason.description: Short reason string. If closing from status==blocked, MUST be paired with unblock_authority per cd-state-machine.yaml.

unblock_authority.description: Required ONLY when transitioning blocked → closed. Names the operator-override per cd-state-machine.yaml (e.g. a charter-merges.md row identifier or an OPERATOR_OVERRIDE: PR-body line ref).

blocked_at_lane_history_index.description: lane-history.jsonl line index at which the block transition was decided.

triggering_tick_record_id.description: Optional pointer (cd_tick's ts or a content-addressed hash) to the tick that decremented TTL to 0 and produced this block; aids audit but is not load-bearing for the (β) predicate.

target_cycle_id.description: UUIDv7 cycle_id of the cycle in which this block occurred. MUST equal the target_cycle_id of the triggering cd_tick when triggering_tick_record_id is present.
